feeds.title: I Heart Local Music
feeds.description: I Heart Local Music is a place for music lovers in Lawrence to gather. It was started out of deep love and appreciation for the local music scene. Our goal is to provide information about all music events and local bands.

feeds.title: Kansas Music Review
feeds.description: The Kansas Music Review is the official publication of the Kansas Music Educators Association, a federated State Association of the National Association for Music Education. It's a must-read for every music educator in Kansas.

feeds.title: Mass Resonator Blog
feeds.description: All the news, events, demos, gear reviews, features, podcasts and videos from the crew at Mass Street Music. Mass Resonator is a hometown guitar shop with world class service, expertise & repair.

feeds.title: University Daily Kansan » Music
feeds.description: Get the latest music news, events and announcements on the University Daily Kansan.The University Daily Kansan is the student newspaper of the University of Kansas.

feeds.title: eXplore Lawrence Blog » Live Music
feeds.description: Posts on live music from eXplore Lawrence.eXplore Lawrence is your one-stop shop for everything you need to plan a Lawrence visit.
